observation.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -c "\l" 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== tables per db ==="; for db in bpmn id notify register filestorage persist_link; do printf "%s: " $db; docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d $db -tAc "select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public'" 2>&1; done
